title: Sleeptalking in mallworld.
content: Good evening everyone, been having Mallworld dreams for a few years now but am a recently new initiate to this subs existence lol. For those of you who sleep next to a partner(or monitor/record sleep habits)do they regale you with wacky and sometimes disturbing somna-speak in the mornings? Sometimes I can suss out relevant phrases to certain dream sequences but oftentimes I’m just perturbed by the random and ambiguous dialogue. I’m going to include some of the sleep talk logs my girlfriend has recorded while I’m off in mallworld. Friday, May 5: don’t eat people. DO NOT EAT PEOPLE.. (gasp) ugh 🤢 Sunday May 13: T: 15 90 to you? Me: What? T: 15 90 to you. Me: Huh? T: They’re 15 90 to you? Me: 😂 About half an hour later.. I’ve seen that one before. It doesn’t have a long (jiggle?) 2 more hours later.. Geogiiiaa! Some crystolaaa! crystolaaa! Do you wanna eat the kiwi? no? Was it good? 5 mins later.. Good mmmmm. About 1 min later.. (Whispers) They said he’d do that May 29: It’s not about the paint it’s about the moon (pie?) May 30: Wacha… wachacha June 23: T: They’re gonna make you carry everything Me: you’re gonna make me carry everything? T: No the owls Me: Lol owls do that? T: Yeah It’s.. it’s just a slugs and (lugs?) July 11: T: Porsarts Me: What? T: Porsarts Me: Porsarts?? T: Will you be the new Porsarts Me: Lol T: I don’t get it 🎶Seromen so..so.. in in🎶 July14: Second take off July16: Crab.. July20: 🎶Liver on guns🎶 September 5: Yeah they’re somewhere in the.. idk Caribbean or ..sub eastern states I just thought they were coming with a pigeon.. never mind. September 26 6:20am: Chitters, cutting, bread and umm… nothing. Humming to “come and get your love” Did you choose a move? Or did yer mind change? (End) As someone who experiences rather high levels of extreme dream strangeness I’d be extremely curious to pick others brain on this phenomenon; what are your sleep hygienes and habits like? Snacks before bed? Sleep playlists? What types of media do y’all consume OR avoid before sleep? As children did you have advanced dreams with complicated motifs not very compatible for kids? Thanks for reading and any insight my fellow oneironauts!
